methodology.kind: controlled direct-backend benchmark with live configured model
methodology.note: Measures this development machine and provider at this time. Scripted answers and shared diagram test runtime contracts; scores do not measure human candidate quality. Small samples do not establish production SLOs.

lifecycle.denominator: recorded rounds with an allocated voice session; unfinished rounds remain in the denominator

cost.note: Requires configured provider rates and complete billable usage. Not an invoice; cached-token pricing, failed requests and provider-specific billing may differ.

quality.note: Valid pinned source references are a coverage proxy, not human-rated relevance or factual correctness.

controls.note: Reconnects are observed presence transitions, not proven state recovery. Recovery success requires a controlled test denominator; disconnect counts alone do not establish it.

coverage.firstAudioMeasurement: voice.response_start is a worker engine-speaking proxy, not browser-audible latency
